prompt: Write 10 distinct notes the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual made about one member each while helping them with: a claim made by the executor of an estate. Each says what will help the next time this agent serves this member: how they like to be dealt with, what is still open, what to check. One or two sentences, third person, no names. This batch leans towards retired members and older homeowners. Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 1)
response: {"items":[{"type":"observation","content":"Member said the claim was being handled by the executor of the estate, so future contact should confirm authority to act before discussing any sensitive details or settlement steps."},{"type":"preference","content":"Member preferred clear, unhurried explanations and to have each next step set out in plain English, with no jargon or rushed calls."},{"type":"fact","content":"The authority to act for the estate still needs to be checked against the probate papers and the executor's contact details before any final decision is made."},{"type":"observation","content":"Member appeared to value being kept updated by post as well as by phone, which may help if they are less comfortable with digital contact."},{"type":"preference","content":"Member responded best when the agent was patient and allowed time for questions, especially when discussing documents and what the estate still needs to provide."},{"type":"fact","content":"The claim remains open pending receipt of the executor's confirmation, any outstanding repair evidence, and final checks on policy cover and excess."},{"type":"observation","content":"Member was concerned about whether the property must be made secure and weatherproof before the estate can progress the claim, so future checks should include temporary repairs and key-holding arrangements."},{"type":"preference","content":"Member preferred a steady, reassuring approach and appreciated a summary at the end of the call so they could pass it on to other family members or the executor."},{"type":"fact","content":"A final review is still needed to confirm whether any items claimed for belong to the estate and whether ownership or usage was clear at the time of loss."},{"type":"observation","content":"Member may benefit from being asked at the start whether they would like the conversation to be repeated more slowly, as they seemed to prefer careful pacing and confirmation of understanding."}]}
